# Josephine Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed 70  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P58](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0058)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Josephine Barry is an elderly woman with thin, prim, and rigid physical features, including wrinkled cheeks. Her sharp, black eyes retain a lively twinkle and snap behind a pair of gold-rimmed glasses.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

## Personality

Josephine Barry is a prim and proper old lady who is known for her terrible temper. She is also rather selfish, rarely caring much for anyone other than herself.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P58](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## History

Aunt Josephine was visiting Diana's house when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) accidentally leaped onto her while racing into a spare-room bed, sparking her fury. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) went to apologize directly, Josephine was charmed by her honest confession and imaginative explanations, prompting her to extend her stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continue Diana's music lessons. She later hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for a delightful week in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) during the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), fondly reflecting on how [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brought life into her home. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), Josephine welcomed her for visits at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## Quotes

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "but I guess she didn’t make much of a mistake after all. If I’d a child like Anne in the house all the time I’d be a better and happier woman."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P32](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0032)

> “I’m afraid my imagination is a little rusty—it’s so long since I used it,” she said. “I dare say your claim to sympathy is just as strong as mine. It all depends on the way we look at it. Sit down here and tell me about yourself.”
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)

> “I’ve made up my mind to stay simply for the sake of getting better acquainted with that Anne-girl,” she said frankly. “She amuses me, and at my time of life an amusing person is a rarity.”
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)

> "Remember, you Anne-girl, when you come to town you’re to visit me and I’ll put you in my very sparest spare-room bed to sleep."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P96](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0096)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry considers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to be a prime favorite, a bond that begins when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally apologizes to her after accidentally jumping on her bed at Diana's house. Anne's candid apology and vivid imagination instantly charm Miss Barry, convincing her to extend her stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continue paying for Diana's music lessons. Later, Josephine hosts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) home during the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), delighting in the warmth and life [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings into her household.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry is Diana's aunt. While visiting [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Aunt Josephine pays for Diana's music lessons and hosts [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her home in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) during the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).
